summary: Iteration 92: Testing Multi-Level Expense Intelligence System with new Behavior Connection section. All 16 backend tests passed (100%). All 4 expense views (List, Daily, Weekly, Monthly) working correctly. Monthly view now includes the new Behavior Connection section with behavioral insights, spending distribution bars, and recurring categories tags.
seed_data_creation: Used existing test user data with expenses across categories
context_for_next_testing_agent: Expense Intelligence 4-view system fully implemented. MyExpenses page at /my-expenses has 4-way toggle (List/Daily/Weekly/Monthly). List view: month selector + expense cards + breakdown. Daily view: calendar heatmap with day-by-day expenses. Weekly view: current week summary (weekday/weekend split), 'This Week by Day' chart, '8-Week Trend' chart, behavior insights. Monthly view: main summary (total, % of income, change vs last month), remaining budget bar, expense breakdown (Essential/Lifestyle/Wealth cards), 6-month trend chart, spending insights, top expenses for selected month, avg monthly/highest month stats, AND NEW Behavior Connection section with behavioral insights (Balanced Spending, Salary Week Spike), spending distribution bars (Weekday/Weekend/First Week %), and recurring categories tags.
